intent: A tablist with roving focus. Pair with TabPanel for linked, accessible content regions.
use_when: Switching between peer views in one surface (e.g. the inspector's Design / Animate).
You need real tablist semantics, not a SingleTab label.
dont_use_when: There is only one view — render a label (SingleTab), not a one-tab tablist.

linked: panels (every tab has a panelId) enables aria-controls + roving focus

a11y.focus: Roving tabIndex: only the selected tab is tabbable. TabPanel is hidden and out of tab order when inactive, and labelled by its tab.

code.example:
<Tabs
  tabs={[
    { value: 'design', label: 'Design', panelId: 'design' },
    { value: 'animate', label: 'Animate', panelId: 'animate' },
  ]}
  value={tab}
  onChange={setTab}
/>
<TabPanel panelId="design" active={tab === 'design'}>…</TabPanel>
<TabPanel panelId="animate" active={tab === 'animate'}>…</TabPanel>
